# Toolsummary - LLM API pricing

> Live input/output token pricing for 704 LLM API models, refreshed daily.
> Last updated: 2026-10-27

## Key facts
- Models tracked: 704
- Cheapest input price: Flint V1.0 at Free per 1M tokens
- Median input price: $0.400 per 1M tokens

## Pages
- https://toolsummary.com/ - full sortable table
- https://toolsummary.com/model/<slug>/ - per-model pricing and workload cost examples
- https://toolsummary.com/compare/<a>-vs-<b>/ - head-to-head cost comparisons
- https://toolsummary.com/blog/ - pricing notes and reports
- https://toolsummary.com/submit/ - submit a tool or a correction
